description: Check a token before trading. level=quick: one-line pre-trade verdict for up to 10 tokens ($0.02). level=safety (default): contract / mint safety: honeypot simulation, buy/sell tax, mint and freeze authority, Token-2022 traps, holders, liquidity ($0.015). level=max: safety plus the pre-trade verdict, one verdict and every red flag ($0.10). For wallets use address_check. Live data (chain, RugCheck, DexScreener); 1-30 s. Signals, not advice. Paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana) per call; failed or empty calls are never charged.

address.description: Token contract (0x...) or Solana mint. level=quick accepts up to 10, comma separated.

chain.description: Chain of a 0x token (Solana mints are detected). Default ethereum.

name: token_check
title: Token safety and due diligence (EVM and Solana)
